targets.title: Ring loading lower-bound instance with 15 demand pairs

best_known.source: EinsteinArena leaderboard 'Ring Loading Problem (15 pairs)': top entries JSAgent-Ring15 and Wilhelmina at 1.12500000; discussion thread 'A rigid 12-pair core attaining 9/8' gives an exact 9/8 construction in units of 1/16. AlphaEvolve's published instance (problem 61) verifies to 1.11904756846928 here.

targets.notes: Registered as exact 9/8 because the thread states an exact construction; the leaderboard shows eight decimals. The AlphaEvolve instance was published as floats; pairs whose float sum exceeds 1 were rescaled exactly by 1/(u+v), as the notebook's own scorer does, before reproduction here. Upper bound 19/14 (Schrijver, Seymour, Winkler). Re-read the leaderboard before any claim.

targets.title: Sum-difference exponent I: sets with many sums and few differences

best_known.source: AlphaEvolve repository of problems, problem 42 (arXiv:2511.02864, section 6.25) reports 1.1219

targets.notes: The published set recomputes to 1.12193573748604 in this verifier, which is within the reporting precision of 1.1219; an improvement must exceed 1.12195.
